newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Electrabel to gain on Powerfin stake sale.
newsitem.headline: Electrabel to gain on Powerfin stake sale.

text.p: Belgian electricity company Electrabel SA will book a large capital gain in its first half 1997 accounts on the sale of its 2.49 percent stake in utility Powerfin to holding company Tractebel, company officials confirmed on Wednesday.

"We bought these shares for around 5,000 francs when their book value was around 2,000 francs," Tractebel chief financial officer Emmanuel van Innis told Reuters at Powerfin's annual shareholders meeting.

According to a footnote in Powerfin's accounts, Electrabel sold the 597,999 shares it held in Powerfin to Tractebel at the beginning of April 1997. The sale was to prevent Tractebel owning a "significant holding of its own shares" following its planned merger with Powerfin, the footnote said.
Tractebel already controls both Electrabel and Powerfin.

Group officials could not immediately confirm whether the capital gain would amount to nearly 1.8 billion Belgian francs, the amount implied by the difference between the selling price of the shares and their book value.
